title: I bought a lemon
text: I bought a lemon. I have had other flex brews of all price ranges and it's a great concept if it works.  For me, it worked well for 3-4 days and then was done.  $40 is not expensive but I expected better.  I know things wear out and it seems like a year is the limit but this was a lemon if I ever saw one so buy with caution.  Hamilton Beach needs to work on their quality control cause there was zero quality in the Flex Brew I purchased.  One star is being generous.
